passages.provision_quote: Performs an abortion knowing that the abortion is sought based on the sex or race of the child or the race of a parent of that child.
passages.note: Bans only sex/race/genetic-abnormality-motivated abortions and public-school-facility abortions; sets no general gestational-stage rule and Sec. 17 disclaims creating any abortion right.
Petersen voted Y on SB1457 final passage, 16-14; the bill bundles several unrelated abortion-regulation clauses, none matching the ladder's gestational-stage dimension.
Petersen is listed as a Co-Sponsor of SB1457, the same multi-clause reason-based abortion restriction bill.

rows.reasoning: The only sourced record is SB 1457 (2021), which Petersen co-sponsored and voted Yes on (16-14 final passage); its operative clauses ban only sex-, race-, and genetic-abnormality-motivated abortions, restrict abortions at public-educational-institution facilities, and add clinic and informed-consent regulation, while Sec. 17 states the act 'does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful.' None of this speaks to the ladder's gestational-stage or exception question, so every passage is adjacent rather than on-question.
needs_source: A vote, sponsorship, or statement by Petersen addressing Arizona's general gestational abortion limit (e.g., a comprehensive gestational-week ban) to establish a chair on this ladder.
